description: Updates one or more sections of an existing innovation record with new content and reports, per section, whether it was applied. Overwrites the specified sections. Text the agent leaves as read keeps its comment threads and pending changes; an applied section also lists any markdown it could not store (dropped) and any comment threads whose text the write removed (detached_threads).

sections.description: Named invention sections and their full replacement text

details.description: Full replacement text for the Further details section; an empty string clears the section

priorArt.description: Full replacement text for the Prior art section; an empty string clears the section

problem.description: Full replacement text for the Problem section; an empty string clears the section

shortcomings.description: Full replacement text for the Prior art shortcomings section; an empty string clears the section

solution.description: Full replacement text for the Solution section; an empty string clears the section

name: update_innovation

detached_threads.description: Comment threads whose anchored text this write removed. They still exist but no longer point at any text; re-anchor or resolve them in the app.

quote.description: The text the thread was anchored on before this write

dropped.description: Markdown the write could not store. Empty when everything was kept.

kind.description: What was dropped: image, footnote, horizontalRule or unsupported

text.description: The markdown as written, shortened when long

marks_incomplete.description: The write was too large to match every edited paragraph to its stored one, so some were stored as new, without their comment anchors and pending changes; the threads on those are listed as detached. Smaller writes keep them.

title: Update innovation sections
